card.name: Small words in planet science texts
card.fires_on: Small linking words (one, from, of, its, has) in astronomy news about planets, stars and exoplanets such as 55 Cancri e, Venus, Mars and Jupiter. The next word often continues a planet-related description.

modes.label: Solar system worlds
modes.description: Linking words in text about Venus, Mars, Jupiter or Vesta and their atmospheres or water.
modes.example: Lying just inside the outer limit of our Sun's habitable zone, Mars remains a frozen world today because<< of>> its thin atmosphere.

card.writes: It pushes toward orbit and planet words, in English and Chinese.
card.plain: It fires on small connecting words in space articles about planets, where a planet or orbit word may come next.
